evidence_summary.binding_rationale: Spacing, windowing, and phase normalization are dataset-specific.
Organ localization can be a trained detector, atlas crop, or segmentation prepass.
3D Swin-UNet, nnU-Net, UNETR, and related models are external model implementations.
Boundary, Dice, Hausdorff, and surface losses are metric- and label-specific.
Connected components, thresholds, and coordinate reinsertion are challenge-specific.
